title: SM-ACC-005B1A: durable tenant-scoped customer identity
authority: Owner requested continuation on 2026-10-31 and explicitly authorized branch upload and PR creation on 2026-11-01: كمل لديك الصلاحيه مني. Accounting-first Hybrid Commerce V6, issue #35.
scope: First customer-identity dependency of issue #35: immutable operator-created customer IDs, exact request recovery, bounded reads, global owner/accountant grants, SQL integrity and tests.
out_of_scope: Identity verification/KYC, fuzzy merging, provider aliases, UI, editing/erasure policy, draft conversion, receivable/journal posting, tax/fiscal issuance, collection, deployment and production migration.
task: Add an organization-scoped customer registry. Preserve drafts and ledger byte-for-byte in behavior. Do not treat unassessed draft totals as final receivables.
validation: Local available lint/type/unit checks; exact-source Foundation, Accounting Web and Governance CI with PostgreSQL migration upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade, replay/concurrency, tenant/RBAC, immutability and audit rollback tests.
stop_conditions: Source mismatch, conflicting PR, failed required checks, unauthorized scope, secret exposure, customer PII in audit or financial side effects.
success_criteria: Permanent customer identity under tenant and permission checks, stable request replay/lookup, explicit operator-created classification and no automatic contact-based merge or ledger effects.
